legacy_data.already_qualified_not_new_runs: Old n=255/511/1023 observations, old two-parameter/four-gamma studies and 30 tests/17 fits are reused evidence and are not regenerated or added to new counts.

bratu.branch: Fresh zero-start Newton, tested smooth smaller branch; no general uniqueness claim
bratu.forward_domain: a-|b|>0 and a+|b|<=3.3+1e-14, inherited. This mathematical forward-model domain is distinct from the inference box. No unbounded method is silently clipped to the inference box.

contexts.data: independent Thomas n31 at [2.9,0.35], generated only after reference authorization

own_controls.lm_damping: Augment scaled least-squares Jacobian with sqrt(mu)*I in z coordinates; gamma is part of objective and must not be changed by damping. Accept only positive actual reduction and gain ratio>1e-4; rho>.75 divides mu by3, rho<.25 multiplies mu by2; rejected step multiplies mu by2. No retry after max rejected steps.
own_controls.gn_linear_solve: SVD/QR least-squares step for augmented residual; never normal-equation inverse
own_controls.parameterization: theta=prior+D*z; gradients/Jacobians transformed with D. All reported convergence gates in physical theta.

legacy_pg_controls.policy: Call exact retained legacy fit_parameters through a canonical-box adapter; retain raw Newton residual-input states and completed evaluate outputs through serial observation-only callbacks, with no arithmetic changes.

scipy_controls.lm_bounds: No bounds; contexts with active-box truth use no LM companion
scipy_controls.trf_bounds: Canonical box transformed explicitly to z coordinates; x_scale=1 because D is explicit.

case65.failure_policy: Own domain-invalid trial is recorded and rejected by the declared line/damping loop, never clipped. Any SciPy residual/Jacobian domain error aborts that fit and is retained/classified; no penalty surrogate, restart or method replacement.

controls.curvature_rule: Accept an update only if yTs>64*eps*||s||2*||y||2; exact-positive but numerically unresolved curvature is a classified stop, not silently skipped/repaired.
controls.bfgs_initial: Identity; inverse-BFGS V H V^T + rho*s*s^T. Symmetric representation is explicitly constructed as 0.5*(Hraw+Hraw.T), with raw antisymmetry recorded. No eigenvalue clipping.
controls.lbfgs_initial_scaling: Identity for empty history, else CURRENT newest (sTy)/(yTy), positive by the curvature guard; last<=3 chronological pairs only.

case67.rng: NumPy 2.0.2 Generator(PCG64(seed)); exactly one standard_normal(5) vector per seed, reused across both sigma and both contexts. Two independent base vectors, not eight independent replicates.
case67.fit_count_formula: 2 contexts * 2 sigma * 2 seeds * 5 gamma + 2 noiseless gamma0 controls
case67.optimizer: SciPy TRF in physical coordinates with explicit Jacobian, canonical box and the same fixed controls as case65; zero-start state every evaluation, no warm-start across gamma.
case67.data_covariance: Sigma=sigma^2 I_5, independent from declared W=I_5/5.
case67.discrepancy: On a COMPLETE, qualified five-gamma path select largest gamma whose weighted residual norm<=1.05*realized weighted noise norm. Realized noise is a synthetic known-noise diagnostic, not a usable unknown-real-data noise estimator.
case67.incomplete_path: Any unqualified/missing required fit means INCOMPLETE_GAMMA_PATH, selected_gamma=None and ellipse=None; no selection from a completed subset.
case67.no_admissible_gamma: Only a complete qualified path with no admissible gamma gets NO_ADMISSIBLE_GAMMA.
case67.l_curve: Four positive gamma points, log weighted residual versus log unweighted parameter deviation from prior; nonzero finite points only. Chord curvature is a descriptive finite-list diagnostic, not a spline L-curve corner implementation.
case67.covariance: At an interior, full-data-rank selected estimate, G=K^T W K+gamma I, C=G^-1 K^T W Sigma W K G^-T. Treat selected gamma as fixed for this plug-in local linearization. Not covariance conditional on selection event and not a Bayesian posterior.
